blocks.raw: The Advanced Filter feature allows you to retrieve charts based on specific KPIs and dimensions. It aids to locate the charts with the KPIs and dimensions of your interest from the list of previously created charts.
blocks.text: The Advanced Filter feature allows you to retrieve charts based on specific KPIs and dimensions. It aids to locate the charts with the KPIs and dimensions of your interest from the list of previously created charts.

blocks.raw:
1. From the left panel, click **Library** > **Charts**.
2. Click **Advanced Filter**.

   <Image align="center" className="border" width="100% " border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/5b9def1-Advanced_filter_Button.png" />
3. In the **Advanced Filter** window, expand the **List of KPIs** drop-down box. From the KPI list select the desired KPI. The maximum KPI selection limit is 20. If you have more than 20 KPIs, select the appropriate KPIs from the sub menu.
blocks.text: From the left panel, click Library > Charts.Click Advanced Filter.In the Advanced Filter window, expand the List of KPIs drop-down box. From the KPI list select the desired KPI. The maximum KPI selection limit is 20. If you have more than 20 KPIs, select the appropriate KPIs from the sub menu.
